name: Robe of Scintillating Colors

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dazzle
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: until the end of your next turn, attacks against you have Disadvantage, and creatures that can see you within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wis save or are Stunned.

summary: 3 charges: a dazzling display makes attacks against you harder and can Stun those who look (Wis DC 15).
text: The robe holds 3 charges and regains 1d3 each dawn. As a Magic action while wearing it, you can spend 1 charge to make the cloth ripple with dazzling, ever-changing colors until your next turn ends. For that time it lights the area within 30 feet with Bright Light and the next 30 feet with Dim Light, and anyone who can see you attacks you with Disadvantage. When the effect starts, every creature that can see you from within the Bright Light makes a Wisdom saving throw against DC 15; on a failure, it has the Stunned condition for as long as the colors last.
